sourceRefs.locator: EMC 1065.0059, obverse and reverse. Entries for ruler, York mint, Raven / Small Cross type, moneyer Æthelferth, spelling on this specimen and weight of 1.17 g.

Rollason, historical sources, the capture in 866–867 and Northumbrian councillors; Blackburn, coinage under Olaf, fig. 82.2 and discussion of the Raven issue under the two Olafs. Craft synthesis, 16–22 Coppergate, pp. 476–481.

note.de: Unter Amlaíb mac Gofraid begann in York die Prägung der Rabenpennys. Einzelne Stücke könnten noch unter seinem Nachfolger entstanden sein. Die Karte zeigt die Münzstadt.
note.en: York began issuing Raven pennies under Amlaíb mac Gofraid. Some specimens may belong to his successor. The map identifies the mint town.
